newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian Forekspank '96 profit 46.5 mln kroons.
newsitem.headline: Estonian Forekspank '96 profit 46.5 mln kroons.

text.p: Estonia's Forekspank, the fifth largest bank, on Tuesday said its 1996 net profit came to 46.5 million kroons, up from 13.5 million kroons at the end of 1995.
The bank said in a statement that net assets at end-1996 were 1.447 billion kroons versus 719 million kroons in 1995.
The bank said that its assets rose due to a 31.6 percent rise in demand deposits and a 21.1 percent increase in term deposits but it did not give figures for either.
The bank said it will forecast its 1997 profits next week.
Forekspank is one of the leading banks quoted on the Tallinn stock market.
